_about: Proposed aiMeta for tasks whose current text contradicts how the shop uses them (docs/goals/SMART_INTAKE.md, D1). Written in the jeweler's shorthand, from the real intakes in test/fixtures/smart-intake/intakes.json. Keyed by task TITLE. Nothing here is live: `node scripts/intake/apply-aimeta.mjs` prints a before/after and writes nothing without --apply and the owner's yes.

symptoms: weld a break in a chain, bracelet, bangle or earring
Laser Weld.whenToUse: The shop's weld for any break or join, on any piece: chains, bracelets, bangles, earrings, pendants, rings. Priced per weld: quantity is the number of welds said. Silver is laser welded here, so 'hard solder' on a silver piece means this task.
Laser Weld.neverUseWhen: Not for joining two rings side by side (Solder Together per Ring) and not for replacing a worn section of shank (Half-Shank).

Size up (1 size) - up to 3mm x 2 mm shan.whenToUse: Sizing a ring UP on a standard shank (up to 3mm x 2mm). The default for every size-up when no shank width is said, however many sizes the ring moves: the task covers the first size and sizing stock is added for the rest. Quantity 1 per ring.
Size up (1 size) - up to 3mm x 2 mm shan.neverUseWhen: Not when a shank wider than 3mm is stated (Size Up 3mm to 5mm), not when the customer supplies the gold (Size Up Customer Supplied Gold), and not for platinum.

Size Up - 3mm to 5mm shanks.whenToUse: Sizing a ring UP when the note states a shank wider than 3mm ('5 mm band', 'wide band'). Any number of sizes. Quantity 1 per ring.
Size Up - 3mm to 5mm shanks.neverUseWhen: Not when no width is said (use the up-to-3mm size-up), not for sizing down, and not when the customer supplies the gold.

Clean and Polish.whenToUse: Clean and polish a piece. Use it whenever the note says clean, polish, or both, alone or alongside other work on the same ticket. Quantity 1 per piece.
Clean and Polish.neverUseWhen: Not implied by other work: add it only when the note says it.

symptoms: missing a diamond, set stone less than 1/2 carat
Set Stone less than0.49ct.whenToUse: Setting a stone under half a carat: melee, 1-point stones, accent stones. Priced per stone: quantity is the number of stones said.
Set Stone less than0.49ct.neverUseWhen: Not for a stone of half a carat or more (use the larger Set Stone tiers). Not for gluing a pearl or cabochon (Glue Pearl).

Set Stone 0.5ct to 0.99ct.whenToUse: Setting a stone from half a carat up to just under one carat. Priced per stone: quantity is the number of stones said.
Set Stone 0.5ct to 0.99ct.neverUseWhen: Not for stones under half a carat or of one carat and over (use the matching Set Stone tier).

Set Stone 1ct or larger.whenToUse: Setting a stone of one carat or more. Priced per stone: quantity is the number of stones said.
Set Stone 1ct or larger.neverUseWhen: Not for stones under one carat (use a smaller Set Stone tier).

symptoms: add a jump ring to the chain
Add 18gu Jump Ring — 5mm and smaller.whenToUse: Add a jump ring, 5mm or smaller. The default whenever the note says 'jump ring'. Priced per jump ring: quantity is the number said.
Add 18gu Jump Ring — 5mm and smaller.neverUseWhen: Not when the note says the jump ring is laser welded (use the 'w/ laser' task). Not for a broken link (Break in chain) or a clasp (Clasp Repair).

Add 18gu Jump Ring w/ laser — 5mm and sm.whenToUse: Add a jump ring, 5mm or smaller, welded closed with the laser. Use ONLY when the note says the jump ring is laser welded.
Add 18gu Jump Ring w/ laser — 5mm and sm.neverUseWhen: Not for a plain 'add jump ring' (use the standard jump-ring task).

Glue Pearl.whenToUse: Glue a pearl, cabochon or other glued-in stone back into its setting ('reglue').
Glue Pearl.neverUseWhen: Not for a prong- or bezel-set stone (use a Set Stone tier).

Solder Together per Ring.whenToUse: Soldering rings together side by side, such as a wedding set. Quantity is the number of joins: two rings is 1, three rings is 2.
Solder Together per Ring.neverUseWhen: Not for a break in one ring's shank (Break in Shank), not for replacing a worn section (Half-Shank), and not for a weld on a chain, bracelet or bangle (Laser Weld).
